name: Radu Stoian MCP Server & Agent Tools
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing dynamic question answering, section retrieval, and external investigation links grounded in the site's knowledge base, plus client-side WebMCP tools.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Answers generic or specific questions about Radu Stoian using a dynamic retrieval engine that grounds its answers by pulling from the site's knowledge base, along with external investigation links.

query.description: The natural language question to ask about Radu Stoian

tools.name: get-section
tools.description: Returns the complete text of a specific section from the site's knowledge base (e.g. 'Skills and Certifications', 'Projects and Clients', 'Client Testimonials', 'Publications and Insights').

section.description: Name or keyword of the section to retrieve

tools.name: get-investigation-links
tools.description: Returns external links and public profiles for AI agents to investigate Radu Stoian (LinkedIn, GitHub, Substack, SpeakerDeck, Credly, Google Skills, etc.).

tools.name: server-info
tools.description: Returns information about this MCP server, runtime environment, and available data sources.
